how_to_play: Select one of your three red marbles (click/tap it, press 1/2/3, or use the hint button)
Drag away from your target to set direction and power (or use Left/Right to aim and Up/Down for power), then release or press Space to lock your shot
Both your shot and the computer rival's secret shot fire together; after balls settle, the closest marble inside the center circle scores
Fallen marbles rest beside the table and return at their home edge next round; first to 5 points wins
mechanics: Simultaneous secret-shot selection for player and AI rival
Drag-to-aim slingshot with direction and power, plus full keyboard aiming
Custom marble physics with collisions, knock-outs, floor bounces, and settling detection
Closest-in-center scoring with tie tolerance and first-to-5 match structure
AI rival that simulates candidate shots with lookahead physics rollouts
Knocked-out marble respawn at home-edge positions each round
Timed planning phase with countdown, pause, restart, sound toggle, and match-result flow
